shape: design/specs/domain/interfaces.md § What the apps ask of the engine
notes: keyed by tally id, because a screen asks about one tally and readTally must answer for that one
the error variant is NOT unreadable: story 04 path C keeps the tally readable and marks pending work pending
units may carry divisor/code/mark — see design/specs/domain/amounts.md
`closing` carries who asked, when, and any date they agreed to settle by — story 05

`offerWriteOff` is the engine's judgement that a remainder is not worth anyone's time. The app must not invent a threshold: what counts as trivial depends on the unit, the parties and the amounts they trade in
